usedFor: Airtable is your table of records; Slack is where the team looks all day. When “New Records Appear” in Airtable, “Send Message” in Slack can tell a channel, or “Send Interactive Message” can ask someone to approve it.

bestTemplate.name: “New Records Appear” in Airtable, then “Send Interactive Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Buttons or a form let the person who sees the new row respond right there, which beats a plain notice for requests and approvals.

watchOut: “New Records Appear” is polling, so a row can sit for a short while before Slack hears about it. On 50agents, an automation's post to a Slack channel also waits for your approval today.
